themes._comment: Per-theme minimal-blast-radius map (Trevor, 2026-07-13). Each js/themes/*.js file resolves to its ONE level screenshot (regenerate with `capture`, not the all-levels catch-all above) and the research/wiki page that GROUNDS its signature mechanic (theme-authoring.md's wiki-fidelity rule: the scene must show the original game's real play, judged against this page, never model memory). Every theme also carries rules .claude/rules/theme-authoring.md + its act file (see levels.md). `research: null` = not a game with a wiki page (terminal/high-score/word-processor) OR a known research gap (see notes). Source of truth: docs/features/level-themes.md frontmatter; keep both in sync. Keyed by theme file; the `js/themes/` entry in `features` remains the coarse fallback.
